title: A scope that grows says why
intro: scope widen adds paths to the task you are working on when the work needs one the scope did not foresee. The task keeps its id; the record says who widened it, when and why.

scenarios.title: Widening the scope of the active task
scenarios.explain: The change under docs was outside the scope, so check refused it. Widening the scope names the path and the reason; the task keeps its id and check now accepts the change.

scenarios.title: Widening without a reason
scenarios.explain: A scope that grows without a reason is the scope creep the scope exists to show, so a widening has to say why.

scenarios.title: Widening when no task is active
scenarios.explain: Only an active task has a scope to widen. Start one with the paths you mean to change.
